ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aqylon Nexus Limited experienced a significant leadership shake-up with the simultaneous resignation of its Managing Director/Chairperson and Executive Director/CTO, both effective September 3rd, 2026, citing personal/professional reasons. The subsequent appointment of a new MD & Chairperson, who is related to an existing director and has comparatively limited experience (5 years in finance), raises immediate governance concerns and questions regarding leadership depth and continuity. A new Independent Director was also appointed with general but limited (4 years) experience.
